problems: A big wooden signpost sits right in the middle of the frame for the whole film (every storyboard frame, all three full-size frames). It covers the centre of the action, and the sheep, crab and blue creature keep going behind it.

The caption says 'it rained glass', but you never see anything falling. The glass beads already lie on the grass or hang still in the air (75% frame, the small beads near the egg plate). Nothing reads as rain.

The caption promises 'a little spot of sun lands on the grass' under every drop. No such spots show anywhere. The beads have ordinary dark shadows, and the only bright marks are a few flat white dots floating in mid-air, by the tree and the basket (50% and 75% frames). Those look like a rendering glitch, not light on the grass.
'My friends chase the spots' is not shown. The sheep, the blue creature and the crab drift around near the camera and the signpost. None of them heads toward any spot of light or reacts to the beads.
In the last third (storyboard row 4, 75% frame), the sheep's head and bow are cut off at the left edge and pressed against the camera. The crab is half hidden behind the signpost.
Floating platform of coloured eggs in the sky (75% frame, storyboard rows 3-4) with no visible support.
posts.critique: Glass that lights up spots on the grass and friends who chase them is a lovely idea, but the film shows none of it. No rain falls, no sunspots appear, and nobody chases anything, while a signpost blocks the middle of every frame. The caption describes a film that isn't there.
